raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 30 duplicate txn_ids are restated rows: each has a record_version=1 row and a record_version=2 row, and silver_transactions keeps both. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id across all statuses, then apply the POSTED filter, so a v2 REVERSED correction is not masked by a v1 POSTED row.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
